verdict.rationale: Framer documents staging environments on a framer.app domain and branching so that changes—including those made by external AI agents—happen in isolation from the main/live project until explicitly merged, which functions as a sandbox for testing without touching production (framer-docs-10, framer-docs-11, framer-docs-25, framer-docs-36). This directly addresses AI-native agent workflows connecting via Claude Code/Cursor/Codex. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that agent-driven branch changes truly never touch production CMS/data, and no evidence of a dedicated non-production 'sandbox' data store distinct from the live CMS.
